name: app-blank-phone-with-two-floating-black-info-chips
title: Empty white phone flanked by black pickup and trip chips with lime accents
whatItIs: A white canvas with a blank white phone at the centre and two floating black rounded chips: a pickup point with a lime target icon at left and a 4-minute trip card with 'live' at right, all with long soft shadows.
whatItMeans: Minimal and staged; the empty screen is the start of an animation.
techniques: Float dark chips beside a blank device.
Show the frame before content appears.

vocabulary.definition: A small UI card outside the device.
A diffuse shadow extending far from an object.
A colour used to signal live state.
